title: Daniel 10 — The man clothed in linen by the Tigris and the angelic-warfare preamble

translation.sourceText: Daniel — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (MT BHS Codex Leningradensis Hebrew primary; 4Q114 (Danielc) preserves substantial fragments of chs 10-11 secondary, supporting MT; 4Q113 has further fragments. Old Greek + Theodotion-Greek tertiary, substantially agreeing on ch 10 with minor variants at the angelic figure's description in v 6). Chapter 10 is Hebrew, the preamble to the final vision (chs 10-12 form a continuous unit). Dated to the third year of Cyrus (537/536 BCE). Major content: the appearance of the man clothed in linen (vv 5-6) whose six-part description directly underlies Rev 1:13-15; the angelic-warfare doctrine of national patron-princes (vv 13, 20-21); the first explicit named appearance of Michael in the Hebrew Bible (v 13).

paragraphs.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס דָּבָר֙ נִגְלָ֣ה לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר וֶאֱמֶ֤ת הַדָּבָר֙ וְצָבָ֣א גָד֔וֹל וּבִין֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר וּבִ֥ינָה ל֖וֹ בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: bi-šnaṯ šālōš lə-Kōreš meleḵ Pārās dāḇār niḡlāh lə-Dāniyyēʾl ʾăšer-niqrāʾ šəmō Bēlṭəšaʾṣṣar we-ʾĕmeṯ had-dāḇār wə-ṣāḇāʾ ḡāḏōl ū-ḇîn ʾeṯ-had-dāḇār ū-ḇînāh lō bam-marʾeh

i18n.en: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a word was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the word was true, even a great warfare; and he understood the word, and had understanding of the vision.

paragraphs.text: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם אֲנִ֤י דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ הָיִ֣יתִי מִתְאַבֵּ֔ל שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: bay-yāmîm hā-hēm ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl hāyîṯî miṯ-ʾabbēl šəlōšāh šāḇuʿîm yāmîm

i18n.en: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

paragraphs.text: לֶ֣חֶם חֲמֻד֞וֹת לֹ֣א אָכַ֗לְתִּי וּבָשָׂ֥ר וָיַ֛יִן לֹא־בָ֥א אֶל־פִּ֖י וְס֣וֹךְ לֹא־סָ֑כְתִּי עַד־מְלֹ֕את שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: leḥem ḥămuḏōṯ lōʾ ʾāḵaltî ū-ḇāśār wā-yayin lōʾ-ḇāʾ ʾel-pî wə-sōḵ lōʾ-sāḵtî ʿaḏ-məlōʾṯ šəlōšeṯ šāḇuʿîm yāmîm

i18n.en: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine into my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

paragraphs.text: וּבְי֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי עַ֣ל יַ֧ד הַנָּהָ֛ר הַגָּד֖וֹל ה֥וּא חִדָּֽקֶל׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḇə-yōm ʿeśrîm wə-ʾarbāʿāh la-ḥōḏeš hā-rîšōn wa-ʾănî hāyîṯî ʿal yaḏ han-nāhār hag-gāḏōl hūʾ Ḥiddāqel

i18n.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

paragraphs.text: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־עֵינַי֙ וָאֵ֔רֶא וְהִנֵּ֥ה אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד לָב֣וּשׁ בַּדִּ֑ים וּמָתְנָ֥יו חֲגֻרִ֖ים בְּכֶ֥תֶם אוּפָֽז׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾeśśāʾ ʾeṯ-ʿênay wā-ʾēreʾ wə-hinnēh ʾîš-ʾeḥāḏ lāḇūš baddîm ū-moṯnāyw ḥăḡurîm bə-ḵeṯem ʾÛp̄āz

i18n.en: I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with pure gold of Uphaz:

paragraphs.commentary: **THE ANGELIC FIGURE** — one of the most detailed angelophanic descriptions in the Hebrew Bible. Seven attributes: linen-vestment + Uphaz gold belt + body-as-beryl + face-as-lightning + eyes-as-fire-torches + arms/feet-as-burnished-bronze + voice-as-multitude. **MAJOR DIRECT REVELATION RECEPTION**: Rev 1:13-15 transfers this seven-attribute description to the risen Christ — one of the most precise verbal-borrowings in the NT from the Hebrew Bible. The Daniel figure is an angel (named at 10:13 as 'one of the chief princes'), not the divine throne-figure; the Rev 1 Christological-transfer is a deliberate move.

paragraphs.text: וּגְוִיָּת֣וֹ כְתַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וּפָנָ֞יו כְּמַרְאֵ֤ה בָרָק֙ וְעֵינָיו֙ כְּלַפִּ֣ידֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּזְרֹֽעֹתָיו֙ וּמַרְגְּלֹתָ֔יו כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֣שֶׁת קָלָ֑ל וְק֥וֹל דְּבָרָ֖יו כְּק֥וֹל הָמֽוֹן׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḡəwiyyāṯō ḵə-ṯaršîš ū-p̄ānāyw kə-marʾēh ḇārāq wə-ʿênāyw kə-lappîḏê ʾēš ū-zərōʿōṯāyw ū-marḡəlōṯāyw kə-ʿên nəḥōšeṯ qālāl wə-qōl dəḇārāyw kə-qōl hāmōn

i18n.en: his body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches, and his arms and his feet like unto burnished bronze, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

paragraphs.text: וְרָאִיתִי֩ אֲנִ֨י דָנִיֵּ֤אל לְבַדִּי֙ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ עִמִּ֔י לֹ֥א רָא֖וּ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֑ה אֲבָ֗ל חֲרָדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ נָפְלָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַֽיִּבְרְח֖וּ בְּהֵחָבֵֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-rāʾîṯî ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl lə-ḇaddî ʾeṯ-ham-marʾāh wə-hā-ʾănāšîm ʾăšer hāyū ʿimmî lōʾ rāʾū ʾeṯ-ham-marʾāh ʾăḇāl ḥărāḏāh ḡəḏōlāh nāp̄əlāh ʿălêhem way-yiḇrəḥū bə-hē-ḥāḇēʾ

i18n.en: And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men that were with me did not see the vision; but a great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide themselves.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֗ה אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁאַר־בִּ֖י כֹּ֑ח וְהוֹדִ֗י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾănî nišʾartî lə-ḇaddî wā-ʾerʾeh ʾeṯ-ham-marʾāh hag-gəḏōlāh haz-zōʾṯ wə-lōʾ nišʾar-bî kōaḥ wə-hōḏî nehpaḵ ʿālay lə-mašḥîṯ wə-lōʾ ʿāṣartî kōaḥ

i18n.en: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

paragraphs.text: וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֶת־ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֑יו וּכְשָׁמְעִי֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֔יו וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי נִרְדָּ֥ם עַל־פָּנַ֖י וּפָנַ֥י אָֽרְצָה׃
paragraphs.translit: wā-ʾešmaʿ ʾeṯ-qōl dəḇārāyw ū-ḵə-šom-ʿî ʾeṯ-qōl dəḇārāyw wa-ʾănî hāyîṯî nirdām ʿal-pānay ū-p̄ānay ʾārṣāh

i18n.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words; and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I fallen into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

paragraphs.text: וְהִנֵּה־יָ֖ד נָ֣גְעָה בִּ֑י וַתְּנִיעֵ֥נִי עַל־בִּרְכַּ֖י וְכַפּ֥וֹת יָדָֽי׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-hinnēh-yāḏ nāḡəʿāh bî wat-tənîʿēnî ʿal-birkay wə-ḵappōṯ yāḏāy

i18n.en: And behold, a hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י דָּנִיֵּ֣אל אִישׁ־חֲ֠מֻדוֹת הָבֵ֨ן בַּדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר֩ אָנֹכִ֨י דֹבֵ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וַעֲמֹ֣ד עַל־עָמְדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה שֻׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֑יךָ וּבְדַבְּר֥וֹ עִמִּ֛י אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה עָמַ֥דְתִּי מַרְעִֽיד׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer ʾēlay Dāniyyēʾl ʾîš-ḥămuḏōṯ hāḇēn bad-dəḇārîm ʾăšer ʾānōḵî ḏōḇēr ʾēleḵā wa-ʿămōḏ ʿal-ʿomḏeḵā kî ʿattāh šullaḥtî ʾēleḵā ū-ḇə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî ʾeṯ-had-dāḇār haz-zeh ʿāmaḏtî marʿîḏ

i18n.en: And he said unto me, "O Daniel, man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto you, and stand upright; for unto you am I now sent." And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ אַל־תִּירָ֣א דָנִיֵּאל֒ כִּ֣י ׀ מִן־הַיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תָּ אֶֽת־לִבְּךָ֛ לְהָבִ֧ין וּלְהִתְעַנּ֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נִשְׁמְע֣וּ דְבָרֶ֑יךָ וַאֲנִי־בָ֖אתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer ʾēlay ʾal-tîrāʾ Dāniyyēʾl kî min-hay-yōm hā-rîšōn ʾăšer nāṯattā ʾeṯ-libbə-ḵā lə-hāḇîn ū-lə-hiṯʿannōṯ lip̄nê ʾĔlōheḵā nišməʿū ḏəḇāreḵā wa-ʾănî-ḇāʾṯî bi-ḏḇāreḵā

i18n.en: Then said he unto me, "Fear not, Daniel; for from the first day that you did set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I am come for your words' sake.

paragraphs.text: וְשַׂ֣ר ׀ מַלְכ֣וּת פָּרַ֗ס עֹמֵ֤ד לְנֶגְדִּי֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאֶחָ֣ד י֔וֹם וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִֽיכָאֵ֗ל אַחַ֛ד הַשָּׂרִ֥ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים בָּ֣א לְעָזְרֵ֑נִי וַאֲנִי֙ נוֹתַ֣רְתִּי שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖צֶל מַלְכֵ֥י פָרָֽס׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-śar malḵūṯ Pārās ʿōmēḏ lə-neḡdî ʿeśrîm wə-ʾeḥāḏ yōm wə-hinnēh Mîḵāʾēl ʾaḥaḏ haś-śārîm hā-rîšōnîm bāʾ lə-ʿozrēnî wa-ʾănî nōṯartî šām ʾēṣel malḵê P̄ārās

i18n.en: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days; but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

paragraphs.commentary: **MICHAEL** first explicit name in the HB. Identified as 'one of the chief princes' — implying a plurality of national-patron-angels. Cross-corpus to 1 En 9:1 (the four archangels) + 1 En 20:5 + Jub 15:30-32 + 1QM (the captain of the heavenly army) + Rev 12:7 + Jude 9 + 1 Thess 4:16. The angelological framework (Israel's prince + Persia's prince + Greece's prince at 10:20-21) derives from the LXX/DSS reading of Deut 32:8-9 'sons of God' allotment.

paragraphs.text: וּבָ֙אתִי֙ לַהֲבִ֣ינְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֑ים כִּי־ע֥וֹד חָז֖וֹן לַיָּמִֽים׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḇāʾṯî la-hăḇînə-ḵā ʾēṯ ʾăšer-yiqrāh lə-ʿammə-ḵā bə-ʾaḥărîṯ hay-yāmîm kî-ʿōḏ ḥāzōn lay-yāmîm

i18n.en: Now I am come to make you understand what shall befall your people in the latter days; for the vision is yet for many days.

paragraphs.text: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה נָתַ֧תִּי פָנַ֛י אַ֖רְצָה וְנֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-ḇə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî kad-dəḇārîm hā-ʾēlleh nāṯattî p̄ānay ʾarṣāh wə-neʾĕlāmtî

i18n.en: And when he had spoken unto me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was dumb.

paragraphs.text: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כִּדְמוּת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ עַל־שְׂפָתָ֑י וָאֶפְתַּח־פִּ֗י וָאֲדַבְּרָה֙ וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ אֶל־הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדִּ֔י אֲדֹנִ֗י בַּמַּרְאָה֙ נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ צִירַי֙ עָלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-hinnēh ki-ḏmūṯ bənê ʾāḏām nōḡēaʿ ʿal-śəp̄āṯāy wā-ʾep̄taḥ-pî wā-ʾăḏabbərāh wā-ʾōmərāh ʾel-hā-ʿōmēḏ lə-neḡdî ʾăḏōnî bam-marʾāh nehepḵū ṣîray ʿālay wə-lōʾ ʿāṣartî kōaḥ

i18n.en: And behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips; then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said unto him that stood before me, "O my lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I retain no strength.

paragraphs.text: וְהֵ֣יךְ יוּכַ֗ל עֶ֤בֶד אֲדֹנִי֙ זֶ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר עִם־אֲדֹ֣נִי זֶ֑ה וַאֲנִ֤י מֵעַ֙תָּה֙ לֹֽא־יַעֲמָד־בִּ֣י כֹ֔חַ וּנְשָׁמָ֖ה לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרָה־בִֽי׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-hêḵ yūḵal ʿeḇeḏ ʾăḏōnî zeh lə-ḏabbēr ʿim-ʾăḏōnî zeh wa-ʾănî mē-ʿattāh lōʾ-yaʿămāḏ-bî ḵōaḥ ū-nəšāmāh lōʾ nišʾărāh-ḇî

i18n.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither was there breath left in me."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֧סֶף וַיִּגַּע־בִּ֛י כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽנִי׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōsep̄ way-yiggaʿ-bî kə-marʾēh ʾāḏām way-ḥazzəqēnî

i18n.en: Then there touched me again one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַל־תִּירָ֧א אִישׁ־חֲמֻד֛וֹת שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֖ךְ חֲזַ֣ק וַחֲזָ֑ק וּֽכְדַבְּר֤וֹ עִמִּי֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔קְתִּי וָאֹֽמְרָ֛ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י כִּ֥י חִזַּקְתָּֽנִי׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer ʾal-tîrāʾ ʾîš-ḥămuḏōṯ šālōm lāḵ ḥăzaq wa-ḥăzāq ū-ḵə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî hiṯḥazzaqtî wā-ʾōmərāh yə-ḏabbēr ʾăḏōnî kî ḥizzaqtānî

i18n.en: And he said, "O man greatly beloved, fear not; peace be unto you; be strong, yea, be strong." And when he spoke unto me, I was strengthened, and said, "Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲיָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לָמָּה־בָּ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְעַתָּ֣ה אָשׁ֔וּב לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־שַׂ֣ר פָּרָ֑ס וַאֲנִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔א וְהִנֵּ֥ה שַׂר־יָוָ֖ן בָּֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: way-yōmer hă-yāḏaʿtā lām-māh-bāʾṯî ʾēleḵā wə-ʿattāh ʾāšūḇ lə-hillāḥēm ʿim-śar Pārās wa-ʾănî yōṣēʾ wə-hinnēh śar-Yāwān bāʾ

i18n.en: Then said he, "Do you know why I am come unto you? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia; and when I go forth, lo, the prince of Greece shall come.

paragraphs.text: אֲבָל֙ אַגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ אֶת־הָרָשׁ֖וּם בִּכְתָ֣ב אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵ֨ין אֶחָ֜ד מִתְחַזֵּ֤ק עִמִּי֙ עַל־אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ֖י אִם־מִיכָאֵ֥ל שַׂרְכֶֽם׃
paragraphs.translit: ʾăḇāl ʾaggîḏ lə-ḵā ʾeṯ-hā-rāšūm bi-ḵṯāḇ ʾĕmeṯ wə-ʾên ʾeḥāḏ miṯḥazzēq ʿimmî ʿal-ʾēlleh kî ʾim-Mîḵāʾēl śarḵem

i18n.en: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth; and there is none that holds with me against these, but Michael your prince.
